nodes.label: Messaging-based State Transitions
nodes.rationale: State transitions are done via messaging rather than direct modification so history can be represented as a tree of messages and reconstructed from an initial empty state; derived from McCarthy's paper.

nodes.label: Runtime Modification
nodes.rationale: Modification at runtime is preferred to 'develop the system in the system', supporting introspection and spiral-up learning.

nodes.label: Introspection Principle
nodes.rationale: Users should be able to introspect/reflect on standard features to develop their own capabilities and spiral up into advanced usage.

nodes.label: Data Loading
nodes.rationale: Load data and create many views referencing the underlying data, possibly through multiple parenting on invisible data-holding nodes.

nodes.label: History
nodes.rationale: Roll forward and backward through history via a tree view with bookmarks to identify key points.

nodes.label: Saving
nodes.rationale: Save top-level window elements to file; requires serialization of all persistent structures and bundling data alongside or by reference.

nodes.label: DSL Bindings / Multi-language Support
nodes.rationale: DSL bindings to all supported scripting languages so users can work across any language to define custom composite nodes.

nodes.label: Primitives (egui widgets)
nodes.rationale: Basic egui widgets fully implemented on the Rust side as a blackbox, self-contained with a defined size.

nodes.label: Composites (Python)
nodes.rationale: Defined in a scripting/extension language (Python), modifiable at runtime; handle internal layouting via zstack/ystack/xstack telling primitives where to draw.

nodes.label: Layouting
nodes.rationale: On draw each parent draws children in a tree passing constraints; metadata stores last-known location/size to enable relative constraints.

nodes.label: Node UID
nodes.rationale: Global within-workspace UIDs generated deterministically by workspace state, required for messaging/mutation/interaction; nodes passed their own UID when drawn.

nodes.label: Node Pool
nodes.rationale: Nodes stored in a flat pool for serialization; every node from every time period exists in the pool, referenced via a workspace lookup map.

nodes.label: Reference Counting
nodes.rationale: Each node is reference counted with two references in the current time period (lookup map and parent); ref-counted values require custom serialization to avoid duplication.

nodes.label: Persistent Shared History Tree
nodes.rationale: Entire node tree in a persistent structurally-shared data structure; histories grained at node and workspace level with time-ordered UUIDs recorded in global and local history.

nodes.label: Queries
nodes.rationale: Synchronous non-mutating operations that may request data from a node during draw; return None when the query is not understood; used for transient mutations.

nodes.label: Actions
nodes.rationale: History-defining asynchronous operations with no return value, buffered and processed at frame end.

nodes.label: Query/Message Trait
nodes.rationale: All queries and messages implement the Query/Message trait supertraiting a boundary-passing trait so they can be defined in Rust or a scripting language.

nodes.label: Control-Flow Graph
nodes.rationale: A global control-flow graph updated when a control-flow line is created; after exec it requests execution on downstream nodes.

nodes.label: Transform exec
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous action run in a background thread on a transform; on completion informs the control-flow graph of the modified (possibly replaced) result node.

nodes.label: Saving / Custom Serialization
nodes.rationale: Custom serialization uses a global lookup map of pointers to serializable values, replacing shared pointers with integer ids to avoid duplication on write and materializing rc on read.
